# Affiliate Amendment: Marrow Agrisupply

**Record date:** 2025-10-02  
**Drafted:** 2025-09-22  
**Executed:** 2025-10-02  
**Effective date:** 2025-10-15

## 1. Parties and Purpose

This Affiliate Amendment is entered into by Pemberline Systems and Marrow Agrisupply in respect of Marrow Agrisupply’s use of Pemberline Dock, the yard and dock scheduling software supplied by Pemberline Systems.

Marrow Agrisupply is a farm supply retail chain operating in the Plains and a subsidiary of Marrow Fieldworks. The purpose of this Amendment is to revise the subscribed seat count and support SLA tier applicable to Marrow Agrisupply under the earlier agreement governing its subscription, referred to in this Amendment as the “Parent Agreement.”

This Amendment records the changes for Marrow Agrisupply only. Its identification of Marrow Fieldworks describes the affiliate relationship and does not amend the terms applicable to Marrow Fieldworks.

## 2. Preparation, Execution, and Effectiveness

This Amendment was drafted on 2025-09-22 and signed by both parties on 2025-10-02. The execution date and effective date are distinct.

The changes stated in Section 3 take effect on 2025-10-15. The signatures dated 2025-10-02 record execution of this Amendment and do not make the amended seat count or support SLA tier effective before 2025-10-15.

The record date shown above identifies the date on which this executed document was entered into the internal amendment record. It does not replace or alter the effective date.

## 3. Amended Terms for Marrow Agrisupply

Effective 2025-10-15, the following terms apply to Marrow Agrisupply:

1. **Subscribed seats:** 40.
2. **Support SLA tier:** Tier 1.

These are the only terms changed by this Amendment. The subscribed seat count and support SLA tier stated above replace the corresponding terms in the earlier paperwork for Marrow Agrisupply.

The designation “Tier 1” identifies the support SLA tier applicable under the Parent Agreement. This Amendment does not separately restate the service provisions associated with that tier.

## 4. Continuing Application of the Parent Agreement

Only the listed terms change for Marrow Agrisupply, and every other term of the Parent Agreement continues to apply to Marrow Agrisupply.

Except for the subscribed seat count and support SLA tier expressly amended in Section 3, this Amendment makes no change to the Parent Agreement. The earlier paperwork remains applicable to Marrow Agrisupply subject to those two substitutions from the effective date.

The amendment is limited to the named company. References to an affiliate relationship, an internal customer code, or an operational location do not extend these changes to another company.

## 5. Administrative Identification and Implementation Record

For internal identification, Marrow Agrisupply may appear in implementation materials as “MAS” or “Marrow Agri.” Those labels refer to Marrow Agrisupply; they do not identify an additional party.

The implementation worksheet accompanying the record concerns ordinary account administration: matching the customer name on the subscription entry, checking the displayed seat count, and checking the support tier field against Section 3. The worksheet includes a receiving-office checklist for the early shift, with separate entries for the dock scheduling desk and the yard check-in terminal.

The receiving-office notes also identify a routine user-list cleanup: removing duplicate display entries for the shared scheduling workstation and checking that the door assignment report retains its existing column headings. Those operational notes do not create additional amended terms. A workstation label, shift designation, or report heading is not a separate subscription commitment.

The completed worksheet is to be filed with this signed record so that the effective-date entry can be checked without treating the signature date as the activation date.

## 6. Execution

The undersigned execute this Affiliate Amendment for the respective parties identified below. Both signatures are dated 2025-10-02. The amended terms become effective on 2025-10-15 as stated above.

### For Pemberline Systems

**Signature:** /s/ June Osei-Lark  
**Name:** June Osei-Lark  
**Title:** Deal desk and contracts manager  
**Date signed:** 2025-10-02

### For Marrow Agrisupply

**Signature:** /s/ Elin Voss  
**Name:** Elin Voss  
**Title:** Authorized signatory  
**Date signed:** 2025-10-02

# Master Subscription Agreement: Marrow Fieldworks and Covered Affiliates

**Drafted:** 24 Mar 2025  
**Written and signed:** 8 Apr 2025  
**Effective date:** 1 May 2025

## 1. Parties and Purpose

1.1 This Master Subscription Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into by Pemberline Systems (“Pemberline”) and Marrow Fieldworks, for itself and its covered affiliate, Marrow Agrisupply (together, the “Customer”). Marrow Agrisupply is a subsidiary of Marrow Fieldworks and is expressly included within this Agreement.

1.2 This Agreement records the Customer’s subscription to Pemberline Dock, Pemberline’s yard and dock scheduling software. Marrow Fieldworks operates an agricultural equipment dealer network in the Plains. Marrow Agrisupply operates a farm supply retail chain in the Plains. Each entity’s subscription is separately identified below.

## 2. Execution and Effective Date

2.1 This Agreement was drafted on 24 Mar 2025 and executed by the parties on 8 Apr 2025. The date of execution is distinct from the effective date.

2.2 The Agreement becomes effective on 1 May 2025. Preparatory activities before that date, including roster collection, site naming, and review of sample appointment records, do not alter the effective date or the subscription quantities stated herein.

2.3 The end of the current term, designated as the renewal date, is 30 Apr 2026 for both Marrow Fieldworks and Marrow Agrisupply.

## 3. Subscription Schedule

3.1 The following subscription schedule applies:

| Subscribing entity | Subscribed seats | Price per seat per year (USD) | Discount | End of current term (renewal date) | Support SLA tier |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Marrow Fieldworks | 90 | 1,800 | 10% | 30 Apr 2026 | Tier 2 |
| Marrow Agrisupply | 25 | 1,800 | 10% | 30 Apr 2026 | Tier 2 |

3.2 The stated annual per-seat price and discount apply to each entity listed in the schedule. The seat quantities are entity-specific: 90 seats apply to Marrow Fieldworks, and 25 seats apply to Marrow Agrisupply.

3.3 References to the Customer collectively shall not obscure the separate subscription entries. Administrative rosters, support submissions, and deployment worksheets shall identify the relevant subscribing entity by its full name.

## 4. Covered Affiliate

4.1 Marrow Agrisupply is the covered affiliate under this Agreement. Its inclusion permits its subscription to be administered within this master record while retaining the separate seat quantity shown in Section 3.

4.2 Marrow Fieldworks shall identify whether an operational request concerns Marrow Fieldworks, Marrow Agrisupply, or both. A request to configure a receiving calendar for Marrow Agrisupply shall not be treated as a request to change a Marrow Fieldworks calendar merely because the entities share an administrative contact.

4.3 Site labels shall distinguish the agricultural equipment receiving operation from the farm supply receiving operation. Similar location names shall be accompanied by the subscribing entity’s name in the deployment worksheet.

## 5. Deployment Records

5.1 The Customer shall prepare a deployment worksheet identifying site names, dock-door labels, receiving shifts, and personnel responsible for maintaining appointment calendars. The worksheet shall separate equipment deliveries from farm supply deliveries where those activities use different receiving areas.

5.2 Initial configuration review shall include representative appointment entries for an equipment unloading bay and a retail replenishment dock. Test entries shall be visibly marked as samples and shall not be issued to a carrier as live delivery instructions.

5.3 Where a location uses labels such as “Door 3” or “West Receiving,” the Customer shall use those labels consistently in its worksheet and appointment instructions. Informal directions such as “the usual gate” shall be replaced with the applicable site and receiving-area designation.

## 6. User Administration

6.1 The Customer shall maintain separate user rosters for Marrow Fieldworks and Marrow Agrisupply. Each roster shall identify the user’s business email address, subscribing entity, and operational function, including receiving clerk, dispatcher, or site administrator.

6.2 Shared shift responsibilities shall be described in the roster without substituting a generic shift label for an individual user’s identity. Departure and reassignment notices shall identify the affected user and entity so that administrative changes can be applied to the correct subscription record.

6.3 Before submitting a roster revision, the Customer shall check for duplicate entries caused by shortened names, alternate email addresses, or transfers between equipment and farm supply operations.

## 7. Appointment Information

7.1 The Customer shall supply operational information appropriate to yard and dock scheduling, including appointment reference, carrier name, scheduled arrival, destination site, and receiving location.

7.2 Appointment notes shall distinguish between scheduling instructions and descriptions of goods. For example, an instruction to report to the west gate shall be entered as an arrival instruction rather than embedded in a description of replacement tractor components.

7.3 The Customer shall review imported appointment data for obsolete door names, missing site references, and duplicate delivery references. A corrected import file shall identify the affected records rather than requiring receiving personnel to infer which appointment should remain active.

## 8. Support Administration

8.1 The support SLA tier applicable to both Marrow Fieldworks and Marrow Agrisupply is Tier 2.

8.2 A support submission shall identify the subscribing entity, affected site, relevant appointment reference, observed behavior, and steps preceding the issue. Where available, the submission shall include a screenshot showing the affected calendar or appointment view.

8.3 For a report that an appointment appears under the wrong receiving shift, the Customer shall include the intended shift and the displayed shift. For a report concerning a missing dock-door label, the Customer shall provide the label used in its deployment worksheet. These particulars support investigation and do not change the subscribed support tier.

## 9. Operational Review

9.1 The Customer’s receiving personnel shall review sample calendars before using them for live scheduling. Review shall cover site selection, door naming, shift boundaries, and the clarity of carrier-facing arrival instructions.

9.2 Review comments shall identify a specific screen, field, or appointment example. A comment such as “wrong dock” shall be supplemented with the intended receiving location.

9.3 The parties shall maintain deployment corrections separately from the subscription schedule. Correcting a door label or removing a duplicate sample appointment shall not amend the commercial entries in Section 3.

## 10. Executed Record

10.1 The signature block below records execution on 8 Apr 2025. The effective date remains 1 May 2025.

10.2 The customer signatory executes this Agreement for Marrow Fieldworks and its covered affiliate, Marrow Agrisupply.

## 11. Signatures

**For Pemberline Systems**

Signature: /s/ June Osei-Lark  
Name: June Osei-Lark  
Title: Deal desk and contracts manager  
Date signed: 8 Apr 2025  

**For Marrow Fieldworks and its covered affiliate, Marrow Agrisupply**

Because it’s pooled, whoever grabs the queue first gets the joy of explaining why the Salina cross-dock can't book three flatbed deliveries into Door 4 at 06:00. # Renewal Order Form: Marrow Fieldworks 2026

**Document Status:** Executed Record  
**Drafted Date:** 6 Apr 2026  
**Execution Date:** 22 Apr 2026  
**Renewal Effective Date:** 1 May 2026  

---

## 1. Parties and Governing Agreement

**1.1.** This Renewal Order Form ("Renewal Order Form") is entered into by and between **Pemberline Systems** ("Provider"), a Delaware corporation, and **Marrow Fieldworks** ("Customer"), an agricultural equipment dealer network operating in the Plains region, together with its subsidiary and participating affiliate **Marrow Agrisupply** ("Affiliate"). Provider, Customer, and Affiliate may each be referred to herein individually as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties."

**1.2.** This Renewal Order Form was drafted on 6 Apr 2026 and is executed by the Parties on 22 Apr 2026 ("Execution Date"). Notwithstanding the Execution Date, the commercial terms, subscription quantities, and pricing set forth in this Renewal Order Form shall take effect on 1 May 2026 ("Renewal Effective Date"). For the avoidance of doubt, the Execution Date of 22 Apr 2026 and the Renewal Effective Date of 1 May 2026 are distinct dates, and the prior term's commercial terms remain in full force until the Renewal Effective Date.

**1.3.** This Renewal Order Form modifies, amends, and supersedes the relevant commercial schedules of the earlier agreement between the Parties governing access to the Pemberline Dock yard and dock scheduling software platform (the "Agreement"), as subsequently modified by the Affiliate Amendment previously executed by the Parties (the "Affiliate Amendment"). Except as expressly modified by this Renewal Order Form, all terms, conditions, definitions, and provisions of the earlier Agreement and the Affiliate Amendment shall remain in full force and effect. In the event of any conflict between the terms of the earlier Agreement, the Affiliate Amendment, and this Renewal Order Form, the terms of this Renewal Order Form shall control solely with respect to the subject matter specifically addressed herein.

---

## 2. Renewal Term

**2.1.** The renewal subscription term governed by this Renewal Order Form shall commence on the Renewal Effective Date of 1 May 2026 and shall continue through and expire on **30 Apr 2027** ("End of Current Term" or "Renewal Date"). 

**2.2.** The End of Current Term of 30 Apr 2027 applies co-terminously to both **Marrow Fieldworks** and **Marrow Agrisupply**. All active subscriptions under the earlier Agreement and the Affiliate Amendment for both Customer and Affiliate shall align to and terminate or renew on 30 Apr 2027.

---

## 3. Subscribed Seats and Pricing Schedule

**3.1. Product Description.** The subscriptions renewed hereunder grant access to the **Pemberline Dock** yard and dock scheduling software platform, licensed on a per-seat, per-year basis for use across designated dealer yards, heavy equipment staging bays, and retail farm supply receiving gates.

**3.2. Subscribed Seats for Marrow Fieldworks.** As of the Renewal Effective Date of 1 May 2026, the total number of subscribed seats allocated to **Marrow Fieldworks** shall be **95** subscribed seats. These seats are designated for named dispatchers, yard coordinators, and receiving clerks operating across Marrow Fieldworks equipment dealer locations (including the Kearney Machinery Annex, the Salina Parts Depot, and associated regional service yards).

**3.3. Subscribed Seats for Marrow Agrisupply.** This Renewal Order Form does not alter or restate the subscribed seat count for **Marrow Agrisupply**. The subscribed seats allocated to Marrow Agrisupply shall remain strictly as set by the Affiliate Amendment.

**3.4. Annual Unit Pricing.** Commencing on the Renewal Effective Date of 1 May 2026 and continuing through 30 Apr 2027, the price per seat per year for **Pemberline Dock** shall be **$1,880 USD** (One Thousand Eight Hundred Eighty United States Dollars). This annual unit price of $1,880 USD per seat per year applies equally to both **Marrow Fieldworks** and **Marrow Agrisupply**, superseding any prior per-seat pricing set forth in the earlier Agreement or the Affiliate Amendment.

| Entity | Product | Subscribed Seats | Price per Seat per Year (USD) | Term Start | Term End (Renewal Date) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Marrow Fieldworks** | Pemberline Dock | 95 | $1,880 | 1 May 2026 | 30 Apr 2027 |
| **Marrow Agrisupply** | Pemberline Dock | As set by the Affiliate Amendment | $1,880 | 1 May 2026 | 30 Apr 2027 |

---

## 4. Service Level Agreement and Operational Continuity

**4.1. Preservation of Affiliate Amendment Terms.** This Renewal Order Form leaves Marrow Agrisupply's subscribed seats and Service Level Agreement (SLA) strictly as set by the Affiliate Amendment. No modification to uptime commitments, scheduled maintenance windows, or service credit calculations under the Affiliate Amendment is effected by this instrument.

**4.2. Operational Scope and Provisioning.** Provider shall maintain continuous provisioning of existing production tenant configurations (`mfw-plains-prod` and `mas-retail-prod`), including custom carrier check-in kiosks at Gate 4 of the Salina Parts Depot, flatbed lowboy appointment templates, and automated EDI 214 carrier status exports, without interruption across the transition on 1 May 2026.

**4.3. Invoicing Administration.** Billing and invoicing for the fees resulting from this Renewal Order Form shall be processed through Provider's designated billing platform, Stoneharrow Billing, in accordance with the payment terms established in the earlier Agreement. Customer and Affiliate invoices shall reference administrative tracking code `ROF-MFW-MAS-2026-04`.

---

## 5. Execution and Signature Block

**5.1.** Each individual executing this Renewal Order Form on behalf of a Party represents and warrants that they have been duly authorized and empowered to bind such Party (and, in the case of Customer, both Marrow Fieldworks and its affiliate Marrow Agrisupply) to the terms and conditions set forth herein as of the Execution Date of 22 Apr 2026.

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have caused this Renewal Order Form to be executed by their duly authorized representatives on 22 Apr 2026.
